revisedDescription: When adding a vehicle by registration and VIN on the home screen, there's currently no way to enter the make and model at the same time — you have to save first, then open the vehicle again just to edit those in. This would add make and model fields right there on that same home-screen entry step.

questions.prompt: Is this the right idea: add make and model fields to the home-screen vehicle entry, alongside registration and VIN?
options: Close, but not quite -- see my comment
